rules: Every client deck: one cover first, D9 Lähenemine second to last, D31 contact last.
Section opener: D82 (zone photo in a gold arch with the zone's cut-out) by default; D8 only when the zone has no photo.
Pick layouts by what the project has: count the photos, cut-outs and words for each zone and choose the layout whose slots match (the field list of each layout shows what it takes).
Use a colour version (cream, olive, wine) to set a rhythm: mostly cream, olive or wine for openers, statements and numbers.
Do not use the same layout twice in a row; vary photo-led and text-led slides.
Special-case layouts only when their condition applies; internal layouts never in a client deck.
Only the two fonts, the layout's sizes and colours; Estonian copy, no em dash; photos fill their slots in the stated ratio.

order.rule: One or two slides that set the look before any zone.
For each zone (room or area) in the order a guest meets them: one opener, then one to four zone slides.
Show the decor items with names and quantities where the offer depends on them.
Optional: plan, kit or quantities when the client needs them.
D9 Lähenemine, always second to last, standard text unchanged.

roles.cover: One cover is required: pick the one that fits the photos you have.
roles.core: Normal choices: pick by the content and photos the project has.
roles.edge: Special case: keep as an option, do not pick unless its condition applies.
roles.internal: Never in a client deck: internal use only.
